description: Georeferenced 3D building reconstructed from real airborne LiDAR point-cloud survey.

geographicLocation.address: 350 State St, Salt Lake City, UT 84103, USA

lidarSource.datasetName: Utah State Capitol / Salt Lake City LiDAR Survey
lidarSource.attribution: State of Utah / OpenTopography. Airborne laser swath mapping data.

stages: 1. Raw LAS/LAZ Point Cloud Loading via laspy (3.48M Survey Points)
3. ASPRS Classification Filtering & Ground Datum Calculation (1,384.50m AMSL)
4. Real Architectural Footprint Polygon Intersection (OSM ID: 32920861)
5. High-Density Roof Surface Extraction (125,539 points @ 18.6 pts/m²)
6. 3D Watertight Solid Surface Mesh Generation (Dome, Wings, Facades, Base)
7. Quadric Error Metric Mesh Optimization & Photometric Vertex Coloring
8. Quality Control Residual Auditing (RMSE: 0.18m, Watertight: True)
reconstructionPipeline.facadeLimitation: Facade geometry limited by LiDAR point density: ALS sensor collected predominantly nadir and oblique roof returns; vertical exterior walls are derived from footprint boundary intersection. Architectural columns and window recesses are not resolved by airborne source LiDAR.

aerialSatellite.label: REAL AERIAL/SATELLITE
aerialSatellite.role: Geographic ground reference (does NOT provide 3D geometry)

dataNotice: Real-world LiDAR demonstration dataset from OpenTopography. External research dataset, decoupled from Indian cadastral/ownership records.
